internshipPrograms.title: Web Development Internship Track
internshipPrograms.description: Master modern responsive web architecture, semantic HTML5, fluid vanilla CSS, JavaScript ES6+, Core Web Vitals optimization, and REST API integration.
internshipPrograms.skills: Semantic HTML, Modern CSS Grid & Flexbox, JavaScript ES6+, Core Web Vitals, Responsive Layouts, Accessibility (a11y)
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Build production-ready responsive web interfaces, optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), and integrate client-side logic with REST APIs.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students or graduates enrolled in Computer Science, BCA, B.Tech, or related technology tracks with foundational knowledge of web development.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Personal laptop or computer, modern web browser, code editor (VS Code or similar), and consistent weekly commitment of 10-12 hours.

internshipPrograms.title: Data Science Internship Track
internshipPrograms.description: Hands-on data science track covering statistical modeling, exploratory data analysis, predictive pipelines with Pandas & Scikit-learn, and interactive dashboarding.
internshipPrograms.skills: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Statistical Modeling, Data Visualization (Seaborn/Plotly), Scikit-Learn, Streamlit
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis, engineer predictive features, train supervised models, and deploy interactive analytical dashboards.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students with basic Python programming knowledge and an interest in data-driven discovery and statistical modeling.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Python 3.10+ environment, Jupyter Notebooks or Google Colab, and 10-12 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: Machine Learning Internship Track
internshipPrograms.description: In-depth machine learning curriculum exploring supervised algorithms, ensemble learning (XGBoost), deep neural networks, and production model serving.
internshipPrograms.skills: Python, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, Ensemble Methods, Model Evaluation, Cross-Validation, FastAPI Inference
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Implement classical and neural models from scratch, evaluate metrics (ROC-AUC, F1), interpret models with SHAP, and deploy real-time inference APIs.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students with foundations in Python, calculus, linear algebra, and basic probability theory.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer with Python 3.10+, terminal access, and 12-14 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: Data Analyst Internship Track
internshipPrograms.description: Business intelligence and analytics track covering advanced SQL queries, Power BI / Tableau dashboards, cohort retention analysis, and stakeholder reporting.
internshipPrograms.skills: Advanced SQL (Window Functions, CTEs), Power BI, Tableau, Excel Data Modeling, Cohort Analysis, Business Metrics
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Extract complex insights from relational databases, model business metrics (LTV, CAC, Churn), and present executive-ready visual KPI dashboards.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students and graduates interested in business intelligence, analytics, decision sciences, and data visualization.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer with SQL editor (DBeaver/PostgreSQL) and Power BI Desktop or Tableau Public, 8-10 hours weekly.

internshipPrograms.title: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking Track
internshipPrograms.description: Defensive and offensive cybersecurity track covering OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, network traffic analysis, cryptography, system hardening, and penetration testing.
internshipPrograms.skills: Network Protocols, Wireshark, Nmap, OWASP Top 10, Cryptography, Linux Hardening, Penetration Testing (Burp Suite)
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Identify web security vulnerabilities, analyze packet captures, implement cryptographic signatures, and draft comprehensive CVSS audit reports.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students interested in information security, ethical hacking, network administration, and secure coding practices.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Linux virtual machine (Kali Linux or Ubuntu), Wireshark, terminal access, and 10-12 hours weekly.

internshipPrograms.title: Software & Full-Stack Development Track
internshipPrograms.description: Practical full-stack engineering track focusing on Node.js backend architecture, relational database management, authentication flows, RESTful APIs, and edge deployment.
internshipPrograms.skills: Node.js, Express/HTTP, SQLite/PostgreSQL, Authentication & Sessions, REST API Design, Git Version Control
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Design and build secure backend services, implement session management and password hashing, manage relational database schemas, and deploy resilient cloud services.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students with basic programming knowledge in JavaScript or Python seeking backend and full-stack software development experience.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer system with Node.js LTS installed, Git, basic terminal familiarity, and weekly commitment of 12-14 hours.

internshipPrograms.title: Prompt Engineering & GenAI Track
internshipPrograms.description: Master prompt design patterns, few-shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought reasoning, prompt evaluation frameworks, and guardrails against jailbreaks & prompt injection.
internshipPrograms.skills: LLM System Prompts, Few-Shot In-Context Learning, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), RAG Context Optimization, Adversarial Testing
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Architect deterministic structured outputs from generative models, build prompt evaluation suites, and design defensive guardrails.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students and professionals seeking practical expertise in generative AI, LLM prompting strategies, and AI application design.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Modern web browser, access to LLM APIs (OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic), and 8-10 hours weekly.

internshipPrograms.title: Autonomous Agent Engineering Track
internshipPrograms.description: Build production multi-agent systems with tool use, function calling, long-term memory architectures, consensus planning, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
internshipPrograms.skills: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Function Calling, Agent Memory Systems, Multi-Agent Collaboration, Guardrails
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Construct autonomous multi-agent teams with specialized tools, implement episodic and semantic memory, and orchestrate complex autonomous pipelines.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Developers with intermediate Python knowledge interested in building cutting-edge autonomous AI agent systems.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Python 3.10+ development environment, terminal, Git, and 12-14 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: AI Engineering & Applied LLM Systems Track
internshipPrograms.description: Enterprise AI systems curriculum covering vector databases, production RAG pipelines, fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA, LLM observability, and scalable inference microservices.
internshipPrograms.skills: Vector Databases (Pinecone/Chroma), Hybrid RAG, LoRA Fine-Tuning, Embeddings, LLM Observability, FastAPI Streaming
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Engineer production-grade RAG systems with reranking, fine-tune models on domain datasets, and deploy monitored streaming inference APIs.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students and developers with Python experience wanting to bridge the gap between machine learning models and scalable software engineering.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Python 3.10+, terminal access, GPU access (Google Colab / Kaggle), and 12-14 hours weekly.

internshipPrograms.title: Android & Mobile App Development Track
internshipPrograms.description: Modern Android development with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM architecture, Room offline database persistence, Coroutines, and RESTful API integration.
internshipPrograms.skills: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM Architecture, Room Database, Kotlin Coroutines & Flow, Retrofit Networking, Material 3
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Develop responsive, offline-first native Android apps using Jetpack Compose, consume REST APIs asynchronously, and package signed Release APKs.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students with foundations in object-oriented programming (Java, Kotlin, or C++) interested in native mobile app engineering.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer capable of running Android Studio, Android device or emulator, and 12-14 hours weekly.

internshipPrograms.title: Product Management & Strategy Track
internshipPrograms.description: End-to-end product leadership program covering Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user story mapping, RICE prioritization, product analytics, and GTM launches.
internshipPrograms.skills: PRD Writing, User Journey Mapping, RICE / MoSCoW Prioritization, Product Analytics (AARRR), Agile Sprints, GTM Strategy
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Draft professional PRDs with technical acceptance criteria, map customer journeys, prioritize feature backlogs, and plan product launches.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Aspiring product managers, tech enthusiasts, and business students looking to lead cross-functional product teams.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Laptop/computer, access to Notion / Google Docs, Figma (basic), and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: UI/UX Design & Product Interface Track
internshipPrograms.description: Design systems, wireframing, high-fidelity interactive prototyping, usability testing, and accessible design principles modeled on modern digital product standards.
internshipPrograms.skills: Figma Prototyping, Design Systems, Typography & Color Tokens, Wireframing, User Journey Mapping, WCAG 2.1 Accessibility
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Create complete design system tokens, assemble interactive Figma clickable prototypes, conduct structured user testing, and deliver developer-ready UI specs.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Designers, aspiring product designers, and creative students with keen attention to visual aesthetics and usability.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Free Figma account, computer capable of web-based design tooling, and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: Graphics Design & Visual Communication Track
internshipPrograms.description: Creative visual design track focusing on brand identity, color theory, typography, marketing collateral, vector illustration, and digital social media kits.
internshipPrograms.skills: Brand Identity, Typography, Color Psychology, Vector Illustration, Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop/Canva, Social Media Creatives
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Design comprehensive brand identity packages, produce high-impact social media creative suites, and build a professional design portfolio.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Creative individuals, students, and aspiring graphic designers seeking professional portfolio development.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer with graphic design software (Figma, Canva, Adobe CC, or Inkscape) and 8-10 hours weekly.

internshipPrograms.title: Human Resources & Talent Management Track
internshipPrograms.description: Strategic HR management track covering technical talent sourcing, structured candidate interviews, onboarding workflows, company culture, and HR metrics.
internshipPrograms.skills: Talent Acquisition, Technical Job Description Writing, Candidate Screening Rubrics, Onboarding SOPs, HR Analytics
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Develop talent sourcing strategies on LinkedIn, conduct structured competency-based screening, and build comprehensive employee onboarding roadmaps.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students and graduates in Management, Business Administration, Psychology, or Commerce interested in HR leadership.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Laptop/computer with spreadsheet and document editor, and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: Digital Marketing & Growth Hacking Track
internshipPrograms.description: Growth marketing curriculum covering Search Engine Optimization (SEO), content marketing funnels, Google Ads, Meta Ads campaign structure, and conversion rate optimization.
internshipPrograms.skills: SEO Audits, Technical SEO, Keyword Research, Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads Manager, Email Drip Automation, Conversion Optimization
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Conduct technical SEO audits, build full-funnel content marketing calendars, run data-backed paid ad experiments, and report growth metrics.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students and marketing aspirants looking for practical, measurable growth marketing and campaign management skills.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer with internet access, familiarity with social platforms, and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: Content Writing & Copywriting Track
internshipPrograms.description: Professional writing track covering high-ranking SEO blog articles, technical copywriting, conversion-focused landing page copy, case studies, and storytelling.
internshipPrograms.skills: SEO Content Writing, Landing Page Copywriting (AIDA/PAS), Technical Case Studies, Headline Optimization, Brand Voice Guidelines
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Produce research-backed 1,500+ word SEO articles, write persuasive conversion copy for landing pages, and assemble a professional bylined writing portfolio.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Writers, communicators, and literature or technical students seeking professional copywriting and digital publishing careers.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer with document editor (Google Docs/Notion) and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: Cloud Architecture & DevOps Track
internshipPrograms.description: Infrastructure essentials covering serverless functions, Cloudflare Workers & Pages, edge caching, CI/CD validation pipelines, and system reliability monitoring.
internshipPrograms.skills: Cloudflare Pages/Workers, Edge Routing, Git Automation, SSL/TLS Hardening, DNS Configuration, Performance Monitoring
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Configure zero-downtime static and edge application deployments, implement automated branch validation, and enforce strict HTTP security headers.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students interested in cloud computing, DevOps pipelines, and modern serverless platforms.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Terminal access, GitHub account, and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.

tracks.title: Web Development
tracks.description: Modern responsive web architecture, semantic HTML5, CSS Grid/Flexbox, ES6+ JS, and REST APIs.

tracks.title: Data Science & Analytics
tracks.description: Statistical analysis, Python, Pandas, exploratory data analysis, and predictive modeling.

tracks.title: Cloud & DevOps
tracks.description: Containerization with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, and cloud deployments.

tracks.title: AI & Machine Learning
tracks.description: Machine learning algorithms, neural network design, model evaluation, and deployment.

tracks.title: UI/UX Design

tasks.title: Week 1: Environment Setup & Developer Tooling
tasks.description: Install Node.js, Git, configure VS Code, and build a semantic HTML5 boilerplate with Git commits.

tasks.title: Week 2: Responsive Layout & Flexbox/Grid
tasks.description: Build a responsive modern landing page component using CSS Grid and Flexbox with mobile-first media queries.

tasks.title: Week 3: Dynamic JavaScript & DOM Manipulation
tasks.description: Create an interactive Task Manager / Todo web application with localStorage persistence and filter options.

tasks.title: Week 4: Capstone Frontend Project & REST API
tasks.description: Integrate a public REST API (e.g., Weather or Products) to render dynamic cards with search and loading states.

tasks.title: Week 5: Full-Stack Node.js & Express REST Backend
tasks.description: Create an Express REST API with CRUD endpoints, request validation, and error-handling middleware.

tasks.title: Week 6: Database Integration & Authentication
tasks.description: Implement secure user registration and login using PBKDF2/bcrypt hashing and token-based authentication.

tasks.title: Week 7: Automated Testing & Security Hardening
tasks.description: Write end-to-end integration tests, enforce rate limiting, and implement secure HTTP response headers.

tasks.title: Week 8: Production Deployment & Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Deploy the full-stack web application to production, achieve 90+ Lighthouse score, and submit live URL.

tasks.title: Week 1: Python Environment & NumPy Foundations
tasks.description: Configure Jupyter/VS Code, master vectorized array operations, and solve 5 data transformation problems.

tasks.title: Week 2: Data Wrangling with Pandas
tasks.description: Clean a real-world messy dataset: handle missing values, outliers, and perform group-by aggregations.

tasks.title: Week 3: Exploratory Data Analysis & Visualization
tasks.description: Generate statistical charts (heatmaps, box plots, histograms) using Seaborn/Matplotlib and interpret trends.

tasks.title: Week 4: Supervised Learning: Regression Analysis
tasks.description: Train a linear/ridge regression model with Scikit-learn, evaluate with RMSE/R2, and document insights.

tasks.title: Week 5: Classification & Model Evaluation
tasks.description: Train classification models (Random Forest, Logistic Regression) and evaluate precision, recall, and ROC-AUC.

tasks.title: Week 6: Feature Engineering & Dimensionality Reduction
tasks.description: Implement PCA and categorical encodings to optimize model performance on high-dimensional data.

tasks.title: Week 7: Time Series & Advanced Forecasting
tasks.description: Decompose seasonal components, apply ARIMA/Prophet models, and forecast future demand metrics.

tasks.title: Week 8: Interactive Streamlit Analytics Dashboard
tasks.description: Deploy an interactive data application on Streamlit Cloud with file upload and live model predictions.

tasks.title: Week 1: Linux Systems & Bash Scripting
tasks.description: Write automation scripts for system health checks, log rotation, and automated cron backups.

tasks.title: Week 2: Git Workflows & Collaborative Branching
tasks.description: Configure branch protection rules, semantic commit hooks, and resolve multi-developer merge conflicts.

tasks.title: Week 3: Containerization with Docker
tasks.description: Write multi-stage Dockerfiles for Node/Python apps, minimize image size, and run multi-container docker-compose.

tasks.title: Week 4: CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
tasks.description: Create an automated pipeline for linting, running unit tests, and building Docker images on pull requests.

tasks.title: Week 5: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
tasks.description: Provision virtual networks, compute instances, and storage buckets using modular Terraform code.

tasks.title: Week 6: Kubernetes Cluster Orchestration
tasks.description: Deploy containerized applications with K8s Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Ingress controllers.

tasks.title: Week 7: Monitoring, Alerting & Logging
tasks.description: Setup Prometheus metric scraping, Grafana dashboards, and configure automated email/Slack alerts.

tasks.title: Week 8: Production Zero-Downtime Deployment
tasks.description: Execute a blue/green or canary deployment pipeline with automated rollback on health check failure.

tasks.title: Week 1: Math Foundations & Linear Algebra in PyTorch
tasks.description: Implement tensor operations, matrix multiplications, and automatic differentiation using PyTorch/TensorFlow.

tasks.title: Week 2: Neural Networks from Scratch
tasks.description: Build a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) with forward pass, loss calculation, and backpropagation.

tasks.title: Week 3: Computer Vision with CNNs
tasks.description: Train a Convolutional Neural Network on image classification with data augmentation and transfer learning.

tasks.title: Week 4: Natural Language Processing Foundations
tasks.description: Build a text classification pipeline using tokenization, word embeddings (TF-IDF/Word2Vec), and sentiment analysis.

tasks.title: Week 5: Transformer Architecture & Attention Mechanisms
tasks.description: Explore self-attention mechanisms, multi-head attention, and fine-tune a pre-trained HuggingFace transformer.

tasks.title: Week 6: LLM Prompt Engineering & RAG Systems
tasks.description: Build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system with vector databases (Chroma/FAISS) and embeddings.

tasks.title: Week 7: Model Optimization & Quantization
tasks.description: Apply model pruning, 8-bit/4-bit quantization, and measure inference latency on edge devices.

tasks.title: Week 8: Full-Stack AI Application Deployment
tasks.description: Package your model behind a FastAPI server, build a lightweight frontend, and deploy to cloud.

tasks.title: Week 1: User Research & Empathy Mapping
tasks.description: Conduct 3 user interviews, build detailed user personas, and draft comprehensive journey maps.

tasks.title: Week 2: Information Architecture & Wireframing
tasks.description: Create site maps, user flows, and low-fidelity wireframes in Figma for an enterprise dashboard.

tasks.title: Week 3: Design Systems & Component Libraries
tasks.description: Build an accessible design token system: typography hierarchy, color scales, buttons, and state variants.

tasks.title: Week 4: High-Fidelity Prototyping
tasks.description: Design interactive high-fidelity desktop and mobile screens with micro-interactions and smart animations.

tasks.title: Week 5: Accessibility Auditing (WCAG 2.1 AA)
tasks.description: Audit existing UI designs for color contrast, tap targets, focus states, and screen reader navigability.

tasks.title: Week 6: Usability Testing & Feedback Synthesis
tasks.description: Run unmoderated usability tests with 5 participants, record task completion rates, and iterate designs.

tasks.title: Week 7: Design Handoff & Developer Specs
tasks.description: Document spacing tokens, export optimized SVGs/assets, and create clear interactive handoff specs.

tasks.title: Week 8: Complete Case Study Portfolio
tasks.description: Write an in-depth design case study outlining problem statement, research, iterations, and final impact.
